detail.longDescription: Most talent leaders we know are working out how AI fits into hiring, ourselves included. Over the past year, our team at Zapier has worked alongside talent and people teams across industries. We've talked with roughly 100 leaders, at companies from high-growth startups to large enterprises. Throughout our conversations, the same problems keep coming up.
